name: Currency Control Package Status 3
definition: Provides the details of each package of currency control records.

PackageIdentification.name: Package Identification
PackageIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of each package of transactions and optionally the entry/record within the package of transactions.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Defines the status of the reported transaction.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Provides detailed information on the status reason.

StatusDateTime.name: Status Date Time
StatusDateTime.definition: Provides the date and time when the status was issued.

RecordStatus.name: Record Status
RecordStatus.definition: Provides the status of the individual records in the package.
